source: Bleak--Quick, The infinite simple group V of Richard J. Thompson: presentations by permutations, Groups Geom. Dyn. 11 (2017) 1401--1436, arXiv:1511.02123v2, Theorem 1.3 (thm:2gen-KB) and Corollary 2.x (cor:2gen-Tietze); relators copied verbatim from the TeX source PresentationForV-FinalVersion.tex, lines 646-655.
convention: right action: x t_{alpha,beta} swaps prefixes alpha and beta; x.(gh) = (x.g).h; conjugation t^s = s^-1 t s
generator_note: u = t_{00,01} t_{10,110} t_{10,111} as a product read left to right under the right action; v = b = (01 10 11). The TeX renders v with a cycle macro; the order-3 relator v^3 fixes it as the 3-cycle, and verify_bq2.py checks both readings of the 3-cycle orientation.
